ti: the harness: generated all-state fixtures, a scripted lifecycle driver over the real tool surface, token and validity metering, A/B against two builds

note: the harness stands: generated all-state fixtures, a scripted driver over the real tool surface with agent-realistic ambiguity recovery, byte and token metering per tool, validity gated on the server severity taxonomy, A/B between two binaries via spectackle bench -against, make bench target. Baseline measured: 3486 bytes, about 871 tokens, for a complete eight-state lifecycle. Found and fixed on its first three runs: expand-built ambiguity refusals still exited zero (a hole in the B-01KYD4H sweep), the blocked escalation is a success not a refusal, and check validity must follow the E versus W taxonomy or it measures the runner instead of the surface

ti: bench fixture v2: multi-dir rules inventory so text-surface changes measure at real magnitude

note: Fixture v2 shipped: four source dirs (api, api/handlers, store, cli) with compilable files, seven lint-clean rules seeded through the real tool surface in an unmetered phase; scripted steps unchanged, all eight states still covered by construction; report totals labeled fixture=v2 and not comparable to v1. Magnitude acceptance exceeded: the state-collapse change class measures -87B and -103B on the two state calls (-143B net vs the pre-collapse binary) where v1 saw -17B — a 10x sensitivity gain toward the real repository magnitude. Acceptance criterion 3 amended with cause: self-A/B is not exactly 0B because time-ordered IDs give adaptive display prefixes that can differ by a character between runs; measured floor ±2B, and the verdict now says tie-within-noise instead of claiming wins inside it. Two harness defects found and fixed while measuring: the A/B section headers now NAME the binaries in each slot, and a -baseline flag allows benching two foreign builds under the current script — both born from a live sign inversion: bench -against makes the ARGUMENT the candidate, and the B-01KYDS archive note recorded its delta inverted as a result. Erratum for the B-01KYDS record: the true delta is +49B systematic on the archive step, not -49B — and the corrected measurement exposed the real cause, the offline forge Ready never persists the draft flip (recorded as B-01KYDV with isolated cause and fix). Coverage tests green including the new multi-dir clean-inventory pin
